41501-how-to-read-human-nature-its-inner.title: Copyright 1913
41501-how-to-read-human-nature-its-inner.creator: Elizabeth Towne
41501-how-to-read-human-nature-its-inner.description: A book by Elizabeth Towne. "Human," of course, means "of or pertaining to man or mankind." Therefore, Human Nature means the _nature_ of man or mankind. "Nature," in this usage, means: "The natural disposition of mind of any person; temper; personal character; individual constitution; the peculiar mental characteristics and attributes which serve to distinguish one person from another."

arxiv-2001-05846.title: A Time-Delay Feedback Neural Network for Discriminating Small, Fast-Moving Targets in Complex Dynamic Environments
arxiv-2001-05846.creator: Hongxin Wang, Huatian Wang, Jiannan Zhao, Cheng Hu, Jigen Peng, Shigang Yue
arxiv-2001-05846.description: Abstract Discriminating small moving objects within complex visual environments is a significant challenge for autonomous micro robots that are generally limited in computational power. By exploiting their highly evolved visual systems, flying insects can effectively detect mates and track prey during rapid pursuits, even though the small targets equate to only a few pixels in their visual field.

arxiv-2209-04977.title: Semi-supervised Triply Robust Inductive Transfer Learning
arxiv-2209-04977.creator: Tianxi Cai, Mengyan Li, Molei Liu
arxiv-2209-04977.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a S emi-supervised T riply R obust I nductive trans F er LE arning (STRIFLE) approach, which integrates heterogeneous data from a label-rich source population and a label-scarce target population and utilizes a large amount of unlabeled data simultaneously to improve the learning accuracy in the target population.

arxiv-2401-14332.title: SunBlock: Cloudless Protection for IoT Systems
arxiv-2401-14332.creator: Vadim Safronov, Anna Maria Mandalari, Daniel J. Dubois, David Choffnes, Hamed Haddadi
arxiv-2401-14332.description: Abstract With an increasing number of Internet of Things (IoT) devices present in homes, there is a rise in the number of potential information leakage channels and their associated security threats and privacy risks. Despite a long history of attacks on IoT devices in unprotected home networks, the problem of accurate, rapid detection and prevention of such attacks remains open.

arxiv-2403-13410.title: Nonparametric density estimation for stationary processes under multiplicative measurement errors
arxiv-2403-13410.creator: Dang Duc Trong, Hoang Van Ha, Thai Phuc Hung
arxiv-2403-13410.description: Abstract This paper focuses on estimating the invariant density function f X f_{X} of the strongly mixing stationary process X t X_{t} in the multiplicative measurement errors model Y t = X t ​ U t Y_{t}=X_{t}U_{t} , where U t U_{t} is also a strongly mixing stationary process.

arxiv-2404-06121.title: Detection of fields of applications in biomedical abstracts with the support of argumentation elements
arxiv-2404-06121.creator: Mariana Neves
arxiv-2404-06121.description: Abstract Focusing on particular facts, instead of the complete text, can potentially improve searching for specific information in the scientific literature. In particular, argumentative elements allow focusing on specific parts of a publication, e.g., the background section or the claims from the authors.

arxiv-2409-06164.title: Deep Learning and Large Language Models for Audio and Text Analysis in Predicting Suicidal Acts in Chinese Psychological Support Hotlines
arxiv-2409-06164.creator: Yining Chen, Jianqiang Li, Changwei Song, Qing Zhao, Yongsheng Tong *, Guanghui Fu *
arxiv-2409-06164.description: Abstract Suicide is a pressing global issue, demanding urgent and effective preventive interventions. Among the various strategies in place, psychological support hotlines had proved as a potent intervention method. Approximately two million people in China attempt suicide annually, with many individuals making multiple attempts. Prompt identification and intervention for high-risk individuals are crucial to preventing tragedies.

arxiv-2503-00028.title: Genetics-Driven Personalized Disease Progression Model
arxiv-2503-00028.creator: Haoyu Yang, Sanjoy Dey, Pablo Meyer
arxiv-2503-00028.description: Abstract . Modeling disease progression through multiple stages is critical for clinical decision-making for chronic diseases, e.g., cancer, diabetes, chronic kidney diseases, and so on. Existing approaches often model the disease progression as a uniform trajectory pattern at the population level.

arxiv-2507-21920.title: Reprocessing of the Parkes 70-cm Survey and Discovery of a New Radio Pulsar in the Large Magellanic Cloud
arxiv-2507-21920.creator: Wenke Xia, Fronefield Crawford, Shinnosuke Hisano, Tai Jespersen, Melanie Ficarra, Mckenzie Golden, Mia Gironda
arxiv-2507-21920.description: Abstract We have reprocessed the data archived from the Parkes 70-cm pulsar (PKS70) survey with an expanded DM search range and an acceleration search. Our goal was to detect pulsars that might have been missed in the original survey processing. Of the original 43842 pointings, 34869 pointings were archived, along with 440 additional pointings for confirmation or timing.

arxiv-2509-03841.title: Exploring the fluid behavior in p+p collisions at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\rm\ TeV with viscous anisotropic hydrodynamics
arxiv-2509-03841.creator: Shujun Zhao, Yiyang Peng, Ulrich Heinz, Huichao Song
arxiv-2509-03841.description: Abstract The applicability of hydrodynamics in small collision systems remains controversial due to the small size and short lifetime of the system. In this letter, we employ viscous anisotropic hydrodynamics ( VAH ), which incorporates large pressure anisotropies, to study the collectivity in p+p collisions at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\ \mathrm{TeV} .

arxiv-2510-12711.title: Enhanced Angle-Range Cluster Parameter Estimation in Full-Duplex ISAC Systems Thanks: This project is funded by Continental Automotive Technologies GmbH under grant DG-088181.
arxiv-2510-12711.creator: Muhammad Talha, Besma Smida, David González G
arxiv-2510-12711.description: Abstract This work studies an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework for targets that are spread both in the angle and range domains. We model each target using a cluster of rays parameterized by a specific density function, and propose a truncated Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) spread (TMS) algorithm to accurately estimate the parameters of the density function.

arxiv-2510-23892.title: Learning-based Spectral Regression for Cocoa Bean Physicochemical Property Prediction
arxiv-2510-23892.creator: Kebin Contreras, Emmanuel Martinez, Brayan Monroy, Sebastian Ardila, Cristian Ramirez, Mariana Caicedo, Hans Garcia, Tatiana Gelvez-Barrera, Juan Poveda-Jaramillo, Henry Arguello, Jorge Bacca
arxiv-2510-23892.description: Abstract Cocoa bean quality assessment is essential for ensuring compliance with commercial standards, protecting consumer health, and increasing the market value of the cocoa product. The quality assessment estimates key physicochemical properties, such as fermentation level, moisture content, polyphenol concentration, and cadmium content, among others.

arxiv-2602-06150.title: Krylov Distribution
arxiv-2602-06150.creator: Mohsen Alishahiha and Mohammad Javad Vasli
arxiv-2602-06150.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mohsen Alishahiha and Mohammad Javad Vasli. We introduce the Krylov distribution 𝒟 ⁡ ( ξ ) \mathcal{D}(\xi) , a static Krylov-space diagnostic that characterizes how inverse-energy response is organized in Hilbert space. The central object is the resolvent-dressed state ( H − ξ ) − 1 ​ | ψ 0 ⟩ (H-\xi)^{-1}|\psi_{0}\rangle , whose decomposition in the Krylov basis generated from a reference state defines a normalized distribution over Krylov levels.

pmc-10743196.title: Structural Characterization and Anti-Inflammatory Activity of Polysaccharides from Tremella fuciformis on Monosodium Urate-Stimulated RAW264.7 Macrophages
pmc-10743196.creator: Wei Deng, Li Wu, Zheng Xiao, Yibin Li, Zhipeng Zheng, Shouhui Chen, Joe Vinson
pmc-10743196.description: The structural characteristics and anti-inflammatory activity of Tremella fuciformis polysaccharides (TFPs) were investigated. The study showed that TFPs were mainly composed of mannose, rhamnose, glucuronic acid, glucose, galactose, xylose, and fucose. TFPs significantly inhibited monosodium urate (MSU)-induced inflammation of RAW264.7 cells, as well as the secretion levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-18 cytokines.

pmc-10744302.title: Control of CCR5 Cell-Surface Targeting by the PRAF2 Gatekeeper
pmc-10744302.creator: Elisa Da Silva, Mark G H Scott, Hervé Enslen, Stefano Marullo, J Adolfo García-Sáinz
pmc-10744302.description: The cell-surface targeting of neo-synthesized G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) involves the recruitment of receptors into COPII vesicles budding at endoplasmic reticulum exit sites (ERESs). This process is regulated for some GPCRs by escort proteins, which facilitate their export, or by gatekeepers that retain the receptors in the ER.

pmc-11440904.title: Perceived environmental uncertainty and job involvement: the mediating role of digital technology and organizational trust - a cross-sectional study in primary care facilities in the UK
pmc-11440904.creator: Liliana Hawrysz, Magdalena Kludacz-Alessandri, Anna Zabłocka- Kluczka, Katarzyna Żak
pmc-11440904.description: BackgroundDigital maturity can help primary care facilities enhance their processes, communication, and adaptability to change, thereby fostering trust and job involvement. This study aimed to examine the causal relationships between perceived environmental uncertainty, digital maturity, organizational trust, and job involvement among managers of primary care facilities in the UK.

pmc-11603684.title: Monitoring drug Efficacy through Multi-Omics Research initiative in Alzheimer’s Disease (MEMORI-AD): A protocol for a multisite exploratory prospective cohort study on the drug response-related clinical, genetic, microbial and metabolomic signatures in Filipino patients with Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11603684.creator: Fresthel Monica M Climacosa, Veeda Michelle M Anlacan, Francis James A Gordovez, John Carlo B Reyes, Ian Kim B Tabios, Rafael Vincent M Manalo, Joana Marie Ceripulo Cruz, Joannes Luke B Asis, Rozel B Razal, Mark Joseph M Abaca, Aira B Dacasin, Ayra Patrice N Espiritu, Nicole Clarence Louise L Gapaz,
pmc-11603684.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionDementia is one of the leading causes of disability among older people aged 60 years and above, with majority eventually being diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Pharmacological agents approved for dementia include acetylcholinesterase enzyme (AChE) inhibitors like rivastigmine, donepezil and galantamine and the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist memantine, prescribed as monotherapy or in combination with each other, depending on the severity of disease. There is currently no available study demonstrating the clinical response to these drugs for AD in the Filipino population.

pmc-11733763.title: Insights from immunomics and metabolomics on the associations between prostatic diseases and coronavirus disease 2019
pmc-11733763.creator: Feixiang Yang, Peng Guo, Kun Wang, Xiangyu Zhang, Zhehao Hu, Qiyue Lou, Qintao Ge, Yiding Chen, Chaozhao Liang, Jialin Meng
pmc-11733763.description: BackgroundThe causal associations and potential mechanisms between prostatic diseases, the predominant male urological disorders, and the course of COVID-19 remain unclear.MethodsA two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was performed to evaluate causal associations between prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia, and prostatitis and different COVID-19 outcomes (SARS-CoV-2 infection, hospitalized COVID-19, and severe COVID-19).

pmc-11976003.title: Assessing Artificial Intelligence Solution Effectiveness: The Role of Pragmatic Trials
pmc-11976003.creator: Mauricio F. Jin, Peter A. Noseworthy, Xiaoxi Yao
pmc-11976003.description: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and other digital solutions in health care has considerably altered the landscape of medical research and patient care. Rigorous evaluation in routine practice settings is fundamental to the ethical use of AI and consists of 3 stages of evaluations: technical performance, usability and acceptability, and health impact evaluation.

pmc-12602091.title: Management of Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Complication Following Limb Replantation: A Report of Two Cases and Literature Review
pmc-12602091.creator: Jingjing Wen, Zhegang Zhou, Johnson Boey, Fanbin Meng, Longbiao Yu
pmc-12602091.description: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) frequently occurs as a perioperative complication following major soft tissue reconstruction. Deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) represent the prevalent forms of VTE. Most of the symptoms manifest in a subtle or asymptomatic manner, complicating accurate and timely diagnosis.

pmc-13062087.title: Respiration as a dynamic modulator of sensory sampling
pmc-13062087.creator: Nikos Chalas, Martina Saltafossi, Teresa Berther, Elio Balestrieri, Omid Abbasi, Daniel S. Kluger
pmc-13062087.description: Respiration dynamically modulates sensory perception by orchestrating transient states of the brain and the body. Using simultaneous recordings of high-density magneto- encephalography (MEG), respiration, and pupillometry, we show that human perceptual sensitivity to near-threshold visual stimuli was enhanced during inspiration, coinciding with respiration-modulated increases in arousal neuromodulation and cortical excitability.

pmc-13311329.title: Data sets on the interaction of FKBP35 from Plasmodium knowlesi and Hsp90 C-terminal pentapeptide
pmc-13311329.creator: Cahyo Budiman, Anna Robreth Robert, Jovi Silvester, Ping-Chin Lee, Kamruddin Ahmed, Thean Chor Leow, Azzyati Mohd Padzil, Meiny Suzery, Kazufumi Takano, Asep Awaludin Prihanto

pmc-13464346.creator: Austin T. Hertel, Cynthia M. McMillen, Ryan M. Hoehl, Zachary D. Frey, Anita K. McElroy, Amy L. Hartman

pmc-13611476.title: Field-Based Neuromuscular and Functional Indicators Associated with Special Judo Fitness Test Performance in Young Judoka
pmc-13611476.creator: Artur Avelino Birk Preissler, Filipe Manuel Clemente, Marcela Zimmermann Casal, Bianca Mariante Braga, Rui Miguel Silva, Carla Gonçalves, Pedro Schons
pmc-13611476.description: Interpreting judo-specific fitness in young judoka requires practical field-based tests that reflect relevant neuromuscular and functional capacities. This cross-sectional study aimed to analyze the associations between field-based neuromuscular and functional indicators and Special Judo Fitness Test performance in young judoka. The sample comprised 36 judoka, including 27 male and 9 female athletes aged 15 to 22 years.

pmc-13616510.title: Failing on Both Sides of the Infarct
pmc-13616510.creator: Richard V. Milani, Carl J. Lavie
pmc-13616510.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Corresponding Author

Few propositions in cardiovascular (CV) medicine are as thoroughly settled as the case for lowering low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C). It is causal, it is dose-dependent, and it is treated with inexpensive, well-tolerated agents. And yet, for most patients who suffer an acute myocardial infarction (AMI), the infarction itself is the moment the health system first acts on a risk that was visible, measurable, and modifiable for years beforehand.

uslaw-usc-t16-s1650.title: 16 U.S.C. § 1650 — Hardwood technology transfer and applied research
uslaw-usc-t16-s1650.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s1650.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 36 (Forest And Rangeland Renewable Resources Planning); Subchapter II (Research). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority of Secretary The Secretary of Agriculture (hereinafter the “Secretary”) is hereby and hereafter authorized to conduct technology transfer and development, training, dissemination of information and applied research in the management, processing and utilization of the hardwood forest resource.
